title: ui: an editable row × weekday matrix input for list views (weekly time entry grid)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Priority p3. The maintainer asked for it on 2026-11-16, when the HotCRM PSA comparison found every PSA product enters time on a weekly grid.

**Need.** Show one row per (project, task) with one editable cell per weekday plus a row total, bound to detail records (one record per row × day). Typing a value creates or updates that day's record, and clearing it deletes the record.

**Today (18.5).** List views offer inline edit per record, so HotCRM's weekly entry (hotcrm PSA 2b) ships as a "my week" list grouped by project, with no model change.

**Ask.** A list-view presentation, or an input component, that pivots detail records into a row × day editable matrix:
- it declares the row keys, the date field, the value field and the week window;
- it writes through the normal record doors, so hooks, validation and permissions apply per cell;
- it shows row and column totals.

HotCRM would switch its "my week" view to it with no data model change.
